title: Where does my food go?
examples: Teacher, what happens to the food after my tummy?
Can you show me the path food takes in my body?
Is the mouth the first place food goes?

explain.say: Say, when you eat food, it starts its journey in your mouth.
Now look! Here it is in 3D: the digestive system. Can you see the oesophagus and the liver? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
Say, your teeth help to chew the food into tiny pieces.
say, after the mouth, the food moves down to your tummy.
say, your tummy mixes the food with special juices to help it break down.
say, next, the food goes into the long intestines to get all the good stuff.
say, when you eat a banana, the mouth starts chewing it first. Then it goes to the tummy, and finally into the intestines.

faq.q: Where does the food go after my tummy?
faq.a: The food moves into the intestines next. The intestines take out the good energy for your body.
asks: Where does the food travel to next?

faq.q: Do I chew food in my mouth or my tummy?
faq.a: You chew the food in your mouth using your teeth. The tummy mixes it later on.
asks: Is chewing done in the stomach?

faq.q: What is the job of the intestines?
faq.a: The intestines are very long tubes. They take the good vitamins and energy from the food for you to grow.
asks: How do I get energy from food?

faq.q: Is the whole process fast or slow?
faq.a: The whole journey takes some time. It is not instant, so you must wait patiently.

faq.q: Do I need to chew all my food?
faq.a: Yes, chewing well in the mouth is very important. It helps the tummy work better later.
asks: Should I chew my food properly?

facts: Chewing in the mouth breaks food into small pieces.
The tummy mixes food with juices to help break it down.
The intestines absorb useful nutrients from the food.
This whole process is called digestion.

quiz.say: Food first goes to the mouth to be chewed.
quiz.why: The mouth is the very first place food enters your body.

wrong.0: The tummy comes after the mouth; it is not the first stop.
wrong.1: The intestines are near the end of the food's journey.
wrong.2: Teeth are tools inside the mouth, not the main location.

quiz.say: The tummy mixes food with special juices.
quiz.why: The tummy uses juices to help break down the food you ate.

wrong.0: The mouth only chews; it does not mix with juices.
wrong.1: The intestines absorb nutrients, they do not mix the food.
wrong.2: The jaw is just the bone that holds your teeth.

quiz.say: The intestines take out the good energy.
quiz.why: The intestines are where your body takes the energy from the food.

wrong.1: The mouth only starts the process by chewing.
wrong.2: The tummy mixes the food but does not absorb the energy.
wrong.3: The throat just helps the food move down.
